design: one variable at a time: the precision term holds the decoy set fixed by comparing the two protocols on the compounds both scored, and the decoy-pool term holds the precision fixed by comparing the funnel over the sampled and the full decoy pool

precision_effect.definition: Glide XP minus HTVS/SP funnel, over the compounds both scored

decoy_pool_effect.definition: full decoy pool minus sampled decoys, both under the HTVS/SP funnel
